description: This file contains examples and demonstrations of Python User-Defined Table Functions (UDTFs) in Spark, including class definitions, registration, and usage in SQL queries.

classes.name: SquareNumbers
classes.description: A class defining a UDTF that yields numbers and their squares, used in multiple examples.

classes.name: WordSplitter
classes.description: A UDTF class that splits input text into words, registered for SQL use.

classes.name: PlusOne
classes.description: A UDTF class that adds one to each input number, using Arrow optimization.

classes.name: DateExpander
classes.description: A UDTF class that expands a date range into individual dates.

classes.name: CountUDTF
classes.description: A UDTF class that counts the number of input rows, demonstrating terminate method.

classes.name: FilterUDTF
classes.description: A class that filters rows based on a condition, used with table arguments and partitioning.

methods.name: python_udtf_simple_example
methods.description: Demonstrates defining and using a simple UDTF class.

methods.name: python_udtf_decorator_example
methods.description: Shows defining a UDTF with a decorator syntax.

methods.name: python_udtf_registration
methods.description: Registers a UDTF for SQL use and demonstrates SQL queries with it.

methods.name: python_udtf_arrow_example
methods.description: Defines a UDTF that uses Arrow for optimization.

methods.name: python_udtf_date_expander
methods.description: Creates a UDTF that expands date ranges.

methods.name: python_udtf_terminate_example
methods.description: Shows a UDTF with a terminate method that outputs a final count.

methods.name: python_udtf_table_argument
methods.description: Demonstrates using a UDTF with table arguments in SQL.

methods.name: python_udtf_table_argument_with_partitioning
methods.description: Shows advanced usage of UDTFs with partitioning and ordering in SQL.
